text:
melissa: Hey — seeing intermittent EOFException / SSLHandshakeException on Android 11 emulator when using the Java SDK (Retrofit + OkHttp). Started after bump to okhttp 4.11.0. Happens behind our corporate proxy. Anyone seen this?

melissa: stacktrace snippet: `java.io.EOFException
	at okio.AsyncTimeout.exit(AsyncTimeout.java:286)
	at okio.RealBufferedSource.read(RealBufferedSource.kt:51)
	at okhttp3.internal.http2.Http2Reader.nextFrame(Http2Reader.kt:105)
	...`

melissa: More logs show `javax.net.ssl.SSLHandshakeException: Connection closed by peer` and then a reconnect loop where requests get 504 or socket timeout.

aaron: hmm — proxy + connection pooling + TLS session reuse smells like a bug. Are you using connection pooling defaults?

melissa: Default OkHttpClient from SDK. No custom pool in our app. Retrofit 2.9, okhttp 4.11.0, Android API 30 emulator.

sasha: There was an okhttp change around HTTP/2 and push/ping handling in 4.11. Could be server/proxy dropping idle connections and OkHttp reusing them. Try `new ConnectionPool(0, 1, TimeUnit.NANOSECONDS)` to disable pooling as a quick repro.

sam: Also try `client = client.newBuilder().retryOnConnectionFailure(false).callTimeout(Duration.ofSeconds(30)).build()` — sometimes retryOnConnectionFailure hides the root cause by retrying on a half-closed socket.

melissa: Good call, trying disable pool + retryOff now. Reproduced reliably in 30 runs with pool on, flaky with pool off.

melissa: Repro steps I followed: 1) Start emulator API 30; 2) Set device wifi to use our corp HTTP proxy (auth via PAC); 3) Run sample app (link: https://internal.redwood/repro/android-okhttp-proxy); 4) Run a steady stream of small chat generation requests (~100 req/min).

julian: Can you paste the OkHttp config you're using in SDK? Might be we instantiate a shared client incorrectly across processes.

melissa: SDK code is basically default: `OkHttpClient.Builder().build()` inside RetrofitFactory. No custom dispatcher. Running on single process, multiple coroutines.

sasha: Two quick experiments: 1) disable HTTP/2 (`protocols(Arrays.asList(Protocol.HTTP_1_1))`) — does that change behavior? 2) set `sslSocketFactory` with `SSLContext.getDefault()` and `connectionPool` with small idle to force new sockets.

melissa: Try 1 now: switching to HTTP/1.1 reduced errors by ~80% in short runs. So looks like HTTP/2 multiplexed stream reusing a closed connection.

aaron: OK that narrows it. I'll open a bug with runtime team — maybe our SDK needs a defensive ConnectionPool config for Android behind proxies. We should avoid long-lived pooled HTTP/2 connections for emulator/old Android combos.

sam: File a small repro PR that changes the SDK's default OkHttp config for Android to set `connectionPool` to `new ConnectionPool(5, 5, TimeUnit.SECONDS)` and `retryOnConnectionFailure(false)` behind a feature flag so we can A/B.

melissa: I'll assemble a minimal repro app and attach logs. Pushing a branch now.

deploy-bot: CI started for branch melissa/repro-disable-pool (build #452) :gear:

julian: FYI, our telemetry shows a spike of these errors from a handful of Android users since the okhttp bump. Looks correlated with requests routed through the corp proxy.

aaron: Created issue RINF-2124 with logs and initial theory (HTTP/2 pool reuse + proxy closing streams). Assigning to eng-runtime.

sam: PR review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/java-sdk/pull/987 — small change, toggles pool for Android when `CONFIG_ANDROID_PROXY_WORKAROUND=true`. Adds tests to emulate closed stream.

melissa: Tested PR locally on emulator and device farm (API 28, 29, 30). With the workaround enabled, error rate dropped to near zero under the same load.

sasha: Great. Can we also add a small note in onboarding docs about Android + corporate proxies & recommended settings? New users hit this pain when they test inside enterprise networks.

aaron: Agreed — adding a short doc in quickstart/FAQ and a sample snippet: ```java
OkHttpClient client = new OkHttpClient.Builder()
  .connectionPool(new ConnectionPool(5, 5, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
  .retryOnConnectionFailure(false)
  .protocols(Arrays.asList(Protocol.HTTP_1_1))
  .build();
```

melissa: Thanks all — marking as resolved for my immediate testing. Leave bug open for runtime to investigate deeper (HTTP/2 stream lifecycle in proxy scenario).

deploy-bot: PR merged to staging (melissa/repro-disable-pool) — build #458 :white_check_mark:

julian: Follow-up: eng-runtime will instrument connection health checks and auto-evict dead HTTP/2 connections. Tracking RINF-2124.

melissa: 👍 thanks — will report back if any further flakiness appears in device lab.
